Use earth's gravitational paremeter mu = 398600.4418 km^3/s^2, earth radius 6371.0 km, and Kepler's law as a rough estimate of the semi-major axis length. Report in a pair of numbers: (average_quiet_rate_km_day, average_storm_rate_km_day). The tle files are located in input/space-track/, with format <NORAD_ID>_storm.csv and <NORAD_ID>_quiet.csv.
